disposition.target: Recovery Workbench Error and Message Standard
disposition.change: Add a no-session (401) message, or widen MSG-P4-001, which v4 defines only as sign-in with no Workbench role. Confirm MSG-GEN-006 'queued and will be retried' wording fits a read refused with 503.
disposition.note: GEN-002, GEN-006, GEN-007 texts copied from Standard v4; P1-001 already matches its template. MSG-P4-001 left unchanged: v4 has no no-session message.
Migration renamed to the V<nnnn> form, taking the next number of rwb-case's own sequence at merge; no number invented.

edits.old: `V012_1__case_list_index.sql` in the rwb-case Flyway sequence after the V0001 baseline
edits.new: `V<nnnn>__case_list_index.sql`, where `<nnnn>` is the next number of the rwb-case service's own Flyway sequence (V0001 to Vnnnn) when the migration is merged, after the V0001 baseline

edits.old: | MSG-GEN-007 | A filter value is outside its list | Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2228; ASM-3677) | This story, before a case is read |
edits.new: | MSG-GEN-007 | A filter value is outside its list | {value} is not a valid value for {field}. Choose a value from the list. | This story, before a case is read |

edits.old: | MSG-GEN-002 | A page size is outside its bounds | Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2228; ASM-3677) | This story, before a case is read |
edits.new: | MSG-GEN-002 | A page size is outside its bounds | {field} must be between {min} and {max}. | This story, before a case is read |

edits.old: | MSG-GEN-006 | The source-data contract does not answer | Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2228; ASM-3677) | This story, on the 503 of X4 |
edits.new: | MSG-GEN-006 | The source-data contract does not answer | {system} is not available. Your request is queued and will be retried. | This story, on the 503 of X4 |

edits.old: The refusal order is fixed: the session, the right,
edits.new: The texts of MSG-GEN-002, MSG-GEN-006 and MSG-GEN-007 are the templates of the Error and Message Standard v4. The refusal order is fixed: the session, the right,
